note: Submodule of search_api_opensearch. Provides one OpenSearch connector plugin, id 'aws_signature', extending StandardConnector to sign requests to Amazon OpenSearch Service with AWS Signature v4. Connector config adds api_key, api_secret, aws_region on top of url + ssl_verification (schema plugin.plugin_configuration.opensearch_connector.aws_signature). Requires aws/aws-sdk-php. No settings page/permissions. This site has no live AWS OpenSearch domain, so medium/hard cases are grounded in search_api.server backend_config (the aws_signature connector plugin IS discoverable/enabled here), not live signed requests. Servers namespaced saws_*.

evals.prompt: What does the search_api_aws_signature_connector module add to Search API OpenSearch, and which connector id do you select to talk to Amazon OpenSearch Service?
evals.expected_output: It adds an OpenSearch connector plugin with id 'aws_signature' that signs requests with AWS Signature v4; you select the 'AWS Signature' connector on the OpenSearch server.

evals.prompt: Which connector configuration values does the aws_signature OpenSearch connector add beyond the standard url and ssl_verification?
evals.expected_output: api_key (AWS access key), api_secret (AWS secret key) and aws_region.

evals.prompt: Which PHP library must be installed for the search_api_aws_signature_connector module, and how can AWS credentials be kept out of exported configuration?
evals.expected_output: It requires the aws/aws-sdk-php library (install blocked otherwise via hook_requirements). Keep credentials out of config by leaving api_key/api_secret/aws_region blank in the UI and setting them via settings.php config overrides on the search_api.server.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the OpenSearch-backed Search API server saws_med uses AWS-signed access. Which AWS region is its connector configured for? Inspect the live server configuration.
evals.expected_output: eu-west-1 - search_api.server.saws_med backend_config.connector is aws_signature and connector_config.aws_region is 'eu-west-1'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the OpenSearch-backed Search API server 'saws_task' currently uses the standard connector, but it now needs to reach an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain with AWS Signature v4 signing. Reconfigure the server to use the aws_signature connector. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: search_api.server.saws_task backend_config.connector is set to 'aws_signature' (typically adding aws_region and optionally api_key/api_secret to connector_config), saved to the live config entity.
